intended_object: An isomorphism between the Mayer–Vietoris short complexes C(A∩B) → C(A)⊕C(B) → C(A∪B) and C(B∩A) → C(B)⊕C(A) → C(B∪A) for subcomplexes A and B of a simplicial set. It comes from the docstring and from how the file uses it, which is to compare the connecting maps when the two members are swapped.
explanation: This is technical bookkeeping inside the Mayer–Vietoris development. The morphism is built from the negated swap isomorphism on the intersection term, the biproduct braiding on the middle term, and the commutativity isomorphism on the union term. Its proofs of commutativity are discharged inside the definition itself. The library uses it only to show how the Mayer–Vietoris sequence and its connecting map behave when the two pieces are swapped. It is an auxiliary construction for proofs, not a standard mathematical object that one could check against the literature.
